facts.business: Swadeshi Industries and Leasing Ltd operates an integrated food processing and distribution business centered around a Food Park at Salasar, Rajasthan, manufacturing a wide range of food products under the 'Swadeshi Aahar' brand with a direct-source, direct-distribution model connecting farmers to consumers.
